title: Feasibility of longitudinal prostate Rmeasurements in patients undergoing stereotactic ablative radiotherapy on an MRI-linac.
publicationName: Physics and imaging in radiation oncology
journalName: Physics and imaging in radiation oncology
snippet: Tissue R* (1/T*), sensitive to deoxyhaemoglobin, is a proposed hypoxia biomarker in prostate cancer. This exploratory work investigates prostate R* and volume throughout and after hypo-fractionated radiotherapy and the effects of androgen deprivation therapy (ADT).
